description.narrative: Income generated from smallholder agriculture increased by 5% in the target rayons

comment.narrative: An increase of five percent in income generated from smallholder agriculture in the selected rayons was the goal targeted under the Impact. This goal was partially achieved.Based on the results of the final survey that was carried out in 2022 there were significant differences in the amount of income generated by the targeted products the reason for which was related to both external and internal value chain factors. Dried persimmon saw a decrease in income generated from USD 4 395 to USD 3 639 17 percent whileowing to the fact that the Russian Federation was a major exporter of this product and the uncertainties and disruptions in the market resulting from the war in Ukraine significantly impacted the price. On the other hand hazelnuts increased from USD 3 762 to USD 4 138 10 percent. Honey also saw a rise from USD 3 250 to USD 3 530 8.5 percent. Persimmon molasses had no baseline but generated USD 1 765 and walnut jam had an increase from USD 722 to USD 882 22 percent. Dried meat saw the most significant increase from USD 5 299 to USD 7 099 33 percent. According to beneficiary statements and observations honey walnut jam and persimmon molasses generated increased profits as a result of the value created by the project while the price of the other products increased owing to inflation in the country.
